dictionary.deposit:
Here is your Firo Tip Bot address: 
%s
Send some Firo here to get tipping.
dictionary.help: Welcome to Firo Tip Bot! Commands: • Reply to a Telegram message with /tip [amount] • Check your /balance • Show your /deposit address • Withdraw with /withdraw [FiroAddress] [amount] • Create a group red envelope with /envelope [amount] Tips by @username are disabled because Telegram usernames can change. Use reply-to tipping so the stable Telegram user ID is used. WARNING: Firo Tip Bot is experimental. Do not store large amounts in it. Tipbot addresses share one custodial wallet and do not give users access to its seed phrase or wallet database.
dictionary.tip_help:
Reply to the recipient's Telegram message with: 
/tip [amount]
Tips by @username are disabled because usernames can change ownership. Reply-to tipping uses the recipient's stable Telegram user ID.
dictionary.incorrect_balance: You don't have enough Firo to send this transaction! Your balance is: %s Firo
dictionary.incorrect_amount: Something isn't quite right with this command. Please check /help for the full list of commands.
dictionary.username_error: This recipient has not started using Firo Tip Bot. Ask them to message the bot with /start before receiving tips.
dictionary.tip_received: You received a %s Firo tip from %s. You must be doing something right!
dictionary.tip_sent: You sent a tip of %s Firos to %s
dictionary.withdrawal_busy: You have unconfirmed withdrawal. Please, wait for confirmations.
dictionary.withdrawal_failed: Withdrawal failed. Check the bot response before trying again.
